We spent 10 days travelling across Germany investigating why Europe’s biggest economy is opening its doors to Indian talent. We met officials, professors, factory engineers, and Indian nurses and students who’ve actually built lives there. This trip changed how we think about what a “developed country” really is. Inside Germany we found a small Indian community that’s thriving and right beside it, Indians who came with the same dream and are struggling. This video showcases both.

Whether you’re curious about how countries work or dreaming of a life in Germany, this video is the honest version - the real salaries, the real challenges, and exactly who this door is open for.
